The lab, co-founded by Reid Hoffman and Mark Pincus, has already signed contracts worth up to $50 million with several customers. Its models have reportedly outperformed rivals on certain benchmarks.
details_he: Prentis is focused on training models to learn how office workers navigate routine workflows, with the goal of building AI agents that can control computers to automate tasks. The startup has already achieved significant traction, with estimated annualized revenue of $75 million by the third quarter of this year. Prentis' edge comes from running a smaller, cheaper model, which it claims is more economical to deploy across everyday workflows. The lab is part of a crowded market, with other companies such as Anthropic and Open AI also working on developing AI agents for computer use.

title_he: Industry’s message on CIRCIA: Please ask us fewer questions about cyberattacks
summary_he: Industry groups expressed concerns about the proposed cyber incident notification regulation, citing an excessive number of companies that would be affected and the potential for overburdening small businesses.
details_he: Industry groups who participated in town halls hosted by the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) expressed concerns about the proposed regulation for the Cyber Incident Reporting for Critical Infrastructure Act. They argued that the regulation would apply to too many companies, with CISA estimating that over 300,000 entities would be subject to its requirements. Some industries, such as the insurance sector, advocated for their removal entirely from the regulation, while others, like the Nuclear Energy Institute, sought to reduce the number of affected companies within their sector. Industry groups also expressed concerns about the type of data that organizations would be required to report in the event of a major incident, with some arguing that CISA should collect the least amount of information possible in the easiest to report fashion to facilitate information accuracy and reporting speed.
